en: The image shows a scenic landscape with two buildings—a white house with a red roof and a larger, chalet-style building surrounded by trees—set near a river or large stream. Behind them, partly obscured by trees, is a brick tower. The top of the postcard bears the German words 'Schiffmühle bei Grimma.', 'Bismarckturm.', and 'Gleisberg-Park.', indicating that these are landmarks or features in the scene.
